en.name: Gregory VIII
en.summary: A pope whose reign of less than two months was consumed entirely by the urgent call for a new crusade after Jerusalem's fall to Saladin.
en.body: Gregory VIII devoted his brief fifty-seven-day papacy almost entirely to organizing the Christian response to the loss of Jerusalem, issuing the bull Audita tremendi that called for what became the Third Crusade and urged reconciliation among Christian rulers to focus on the crusading effort. He died before any of the resulting campaigns could get underway.
